comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Discovered in the hidden passages in Giza Mid. I got this in a big room with two chests after going into the hidden passage from floor 4. Defeated everyone in land battle without going after the yellow orbs. Apparently, according to comments from the JP wiki, the special room with the discovery only has a 5-10% chance of appearing. Waiting about 5 minutes before engaging in combat/unlocking the traps, and having the Thief Eyes 1 Boston skill from Thief job may help increase the odds.
